ppe_note: Velista irritates the eyes: goggles and a hat when you weigh and pour it. Lexicon: elbow gloves. Buff-It has no SDS on file: goggles.
spray_rules: Every part of each green. Box out each green first, then fill in. Surrounds don't need it
Water in as you go: the moment a green is sprayed, run that green on program #24 (about 2 mm). It must go on within 1 hour (Velista label). No waiting for it to dry
Good morning for it: Delta T 2.0 at 7, 3.1 at 9, under 5 till noon. ESE 7–9 km/h, gusts under 22 till noon. Southerly from 2 pm, gusting 30+ by 4 pm. Stop if the wind is over 20 km/h
Never spray near golfers: work in the gaps behind groups. Keep people off each green until it's watered in
Tell Andy when the last green is watered in: tonight's irrigation tops it up
spray_more: Velista label: wind 3–20 km/h, no spraying in an inversion, medium droplets or coarser, irrigate within 1 hour with 6–10 mm in total. Lexicon label: keep people off until it's dry or watered in, don't irrigate to the point of runoff for 3 days.

flags.t: JD's last tank was Brek: no record it was cleaned out
flags.d: The 16 Nov fairway tank in the JD was Brek 500 SC (propyzamide) + LuxiMax. Brek's label: do not use on bent grass. No mix or post-application sign-off came through for that tank, so nothing confirms the JD was decontaminated. Tank cleaner and a triple rinse through tank, boom, filters and nozzles before this tank, unless you know it's done.
flags.s: Brek 500 SC label · Spray Records (Notion), checked 18 Nov 5:30 am

flags.t: Storms forecast Friday: inside Lexicon's 3-day restraint
flags.d: Lexicon label: don't apply if heavy rain or storms are forecast within 3 days. Forecast: a shower Thu night (about 1.7 mm), then Fri heavy showers (about 6.4 mm, thunderstorms 26% by day, 43% Fri evening). Totals are light and the product will be two days into the root zone, so runoff risk is low, but it is a label condition.
flags.s: BASF Lexicon label (Apr 2023) · AccuWeather Botanic Ridge, 18 Nov 5:24 am

flags.t: Two Group 7 (SDHI) fungicides in one tank
flags.d: Velista (penthiopyrad) and Lexicon (fluxapyroxad) are both Group 7 and both labelled for fairy ring. Legal at these rates, but it doubles up one mode of action. Velista: max 2 consecutive, then 2 sprays of another group before reuse, and no more than a third of the year's fungicide sprays. Lexicon: max 3 in a row for fairy ring, 2 for Pythium, 6 L/ha a year. Plan the next fairy ring and Pythium sprays around a non-SDHI.
flags.s: Velista label APVMA 65718 · BASF Lexicon label (Apr 2023)

flags.t: Wash-in: 2 mm now, the rest tonight
flags.d: Velista wants 6–10 mm within 1 hour. Program #24 puts about 2 mm on each green now (1.7–2.2 mm by head), and tonight's irrigation brings the total up. Lexicon: no irrigating to the point of runoff for 3 days, so cycle and soak tonight.
flags.s: Velista label · Lexicon label · Cirrus Pro program #24

flags.t: 600 L/ha is under Velista's fairy ring water volume
flags.d: Velista label: about 1000 L/ha with air-induction 08 nozzles, plus a non-ionic surfactant at 0.25%. At 600 L/ha the wash-in does more of the work, so start each green straight after spraying. HydroForce does the wetting job in the root zone; there's no leaf surfactant in this tank.
GreenKeeper showed no HydroForce Ultra on the shelf on 17 Nov. Check before Brodie fills.

flags.t: Pythium cover here is root zone, not leaf
flags.d: Lexicon covers Pythium blight (leaf) and Pythium root dysfunction (root, irrigate straight after) at 1.5 L/ha. Watered in straight away, this tank is the root-zone use. Leaf cover for Pythium blight will be light.

flags.t: HydroForce 12.5 L/ha is its monthly greens rate
flags.d: Tech sheet: 12.5 L/ha every 30 days (curative 12.5–19 L/ha), then a light irrigation. Last on greens 19–20 Oct at 6 L/ha.

flags.t: Boom setup checks out: about 600 L/ha
flags.d: White Wilger SR110-08 is rated 0.8 US gpm at 2.8 bar, so about 3.7 L/min at 4.1 bar. On 75 cm spacing at 4.9 km/h that's about 600 L/ha, matching the GreenKeeper config.
flags.s: Wilger rated flows · GreenKeeper JD 600 L/ha White config

flags.d: Lexicon (suspension concentrate) moves ahead of HydroForce, following Velista's mixing order: granules, then suspension concentrates, then surfactants last. Most of the water goes in before HydroForce so it doesn't foam.
